reason: The v1 outcome records retain one repeated head-camera video plus per-step actions and states. Official pi0.5 RoboTwin training consumes head, left-wrist, and right-wrist images at each policy query, so v1 outcomes alone are not trainable under the matched public recipe.
finalization_amendment: The two base collectors intentionally cover disjoint three-task subsets of the unchanged 24-cell scene manifest. Finalization now passes each predeclared task and eval-seed subset explicitly, so the manifest builder requires exactly six shard cells instead of incorrectly requiring all 24 cells from each shard. All derived query manifests are written under the local logs tree because East result directories are root-owned; source artifacts remain immutable and all relative paths are rebased by the builders.

frozen_design.collection_unit: the three camera images, 14-D state, exact instruction, and frame index at every real policy query
frozen_design.train_scenes: every train-split scene in the accepted balanced combined v1 outcome manifest, with no outcome-dependent stopping or filtering
base_parallelization: East GPUs 0-1: both train seeds for beat_block_hammer, blocks_ranking_size, blocks_ranking_rgb
East GPUs 2-3: both train seeds for handover_block, stack_blocks_two, stack_blocks_three
frozen_design.support_parallelization: local GPUs 0-1 capture both train seeds for all beat_block_hammer support scenes; two disjoint East 2-GPU shards capture the remaining five tasks, yielding 100 train trajectories per task
frozen_design.training_authorization: requires both the accepted outcome audit and the accepted three-camera query audit
